title: Headless import reports progress of greater than 100% if GLTF files are present
body:
### Tested versions

- Reproducible in: 4.5.beta [8acc596bcfbeab009c2aded1e9da20448d392fdc]
- Not reproducible in: 4.4.1.stable

### System information

Godot v4.5.beta (8acc596bc) - Fedora Linux 42 (Adams) on Wayland - X11 display driver, Multi-window, 2 monitors - Vulkan (Forward+) - dedicated AMD Radeon RX 9070 XT (RADV GFX1201) - AMD Ryzen 9 9950X3D 16-Core Processor (32 threads) - 60.39 GiB memory

### Issue description

Whenever there's a GLTF file in the project, and you run `--headless --import` (and presumably during `--headless --export` as well) you'll see logs that look something like this, where certain messages report a progress greater than 100%:

```

[ DONE ] first_scan_filesystem

[   0% ] _update_scan_actions | Started Scanning actions... (6 steps)
[   0% ] _update_scan_actions | 1.png
[  14% ] _update_scan_actions | 2.png

[  42% ] _update_scan_actions | 4.png

[   1% ] import | Running Custom Script...

ERROR: Parameter "t" is null.
   at: texture_2d_get (servers/rendering/dummy/storage/texture_storage.h:106)
[ DONE ] import

[   5% ] reimport | Finalizing Asset Import...
[ DONE ] reimport

[   0% ] reimport | Started (Re)Importing Assets (6 steps)

[ DONE ] loading_editor_layout

```

### Steps to reproduce

1. Unpack the MRP.
2. Run Godot with `--headless --import` in the MRP folder.
3. Note percentages greater than 100% for the `*.png` and `*.glb` files during the `reimport` step.
4. Delete `box.glb`.
5. Delete the `.godot` folder.
6. Run `--headless --import` again.
7. Note how the percentages are fine.

### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

[glb-import-progress.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/21443109/glb-import-progress.zip)
